SERVICE_CONTEXT.service_summary: Community colleges are operated by the state in which the college is located. They offer a free or low price way for residents of that state to get certificates or a 2 year (Associate) degree. At the completion of an Associate degree, many students will transfer to a school where they can get a Bachelor degree.  Some community colleges have agreements with state schools for guaranteed transfer. Mo
